findings:
🟠 [counts-root-bound] MUST-FIX Per-root scope files compute fresh_bound_s from the root's own live_candidates (computeCounts(scopeRows(rows, root), …)), but the collector's bounded rotation runs over the whole project candidate set, so with several roots the root bound understates the real re-probe window (e.g. 3 roots x 8 live, cap 8, interval 10: project bound 60, root bound 20, rotation period 30 s) and rows the watcher did probe within the rotation are reported unknown in `<key>--<root>.json` while confirmed_live in `<key>.json`; impact: inconsistent counts across scope files and false unknown for per-root readers. Smallest remediation: compute freshBound once from the project-wide candidate count in tick() and pass it into computeCounts for every scope (add an optional bound argument), keeping sum == runs.length per scope; add a two-root assertion that root files carry the project-wide fresh_bound_s.
🔵 [idle-exit-rearm] CUT/FOLLOW-UP When an unexpired marker held the watcher open past N s of idle, idleSince keeps accumulating and the watcher exits on the very first tick after the marker expires rather than waiting N s more; the hard invariant (never exits while an unexpired same-project marker exists) holds, so excluded from this version.
🔵 [observed-at-cost-drift] CUT/FOLLOW-UP Cost totals and count flips are folded into the change signature, so a UTC-midnight host_today_usd reset or a probe_age crossing the bound republishes with a new observed_at even when runs are unchanged; acceptable since each tick is a real re-query, note for P1b readers.
🔵 [cost-path-comment] CUT/FOLLOW-UP Comment says resolution matches hooks/cost-fuse.js while depth-0 cites hooks/cost-tracker.js; behavior ($AUTOPILOT_COSTS_FILE else ~/.claude/metrics/costs.jsonl) matches the approved decision, comment only.
